test_title: PYST 155: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 06 Feb, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, STAR is coded as 58, and ALARM is coded as 45. How will STAGE be coded in the same language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/229413eb8308d75c9d1aa60c41e6ccd223eed38209f3156b9aa9c3e73a28cfe3.png] ​

**Logic: Addition of the positional value of the alphabet.**

STAR is coded as 58 →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3400904405f9648e0b66f28af8c370cab1fcc4d0c80e65237733a2d1cb56408.png] 

ALARM is coded as 45 →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4567923ababc17d81b15bdd80f7415b594ee709b69830d659ec452f7d7993efa.png] 

Similarly, 'STAGE' will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b738680a9adfb4c7d5cea41c6c345d8ac19ce997116076e7c55a59558b6c4dd.png] 

Here, 'STAGE' is coded as **'52'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
